Game Overview

In Fishing Dancing, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a retro, neon-lit experience with Fishing Dancing, where the thrill of fishing meets the beat of retrowave tunes. Cast your line in time with the music, mastering unique fish rhythms in a nostalgic 80s setting. Perfect timing and quick reflexes will hook you on high scores!
